validationPromotionPolicy: Synthetic mode is ENGINE_VALIDATION_SYNTHETIC only and must emit DATASET_INSUFFICIENT / RESEARCH_CONTINUE, never PROMOTION_CANDIDATE.

strategies.entry: At decision bar idx, after lookback warmup, compute standardized delta z=(current.delta-mean(prior 20 deltas))/pstdev(prior 20 deltas). Long if z>=1.5, order_imbalance>=0.45, abs(close-vwap)/close<=0.01, and close breaks above prior 5-bar high. Short mirrors with z<=-1.5, order_imbalance<=-0.45, and close below prior 5-bar low.
strategies.entryTiming: Decision at bar idx; fill no earlier than next bar open/snapshot.
strategies.exitOrder: TAKER in frozen adapter; scenario STRESS_2/STRESS_3 can force taker-heavy exits.
strategies.stop: 20 bps adverse from actual entry reference price.
strategies.takeProfit: 35 bps favorable from actual entry reference price.
strategies.invalidation: No signal before max(20 delta lookback, 5 breakout lookback); no signal if prior delta standard deviation is zero; no same-bar entry.
strategies.sizing: Fixed 1000 USD notional per trade by default, one open position per strategy run.

strategies.implementation: strategies.InstitutionalAbsorptionFade (compatibility class name; report name Absorption Fade)
strategies.entry: Two consecutive intervals must confirm absorption proxy. Long after two bars each have absorption_score>=2.5, order_imbalance<=-0.30, bid_skew>=0.35. Short mirrors with order_imbalance>=0.30 and bid_skew<=-0.35.
strategies.entryTiming: Decision at bar idx after second confirmation; fill no earlier than next bar open/snapshot.
strategies.entryOrder: MAKER; synthetic maker fill is ASSUMED, not book-executable.
strategies.exitOrder: MAKER unless stress scenario forces taker-heavy exits; synthetic maker fill is ASSUMED.
strategies.stop: 18 bps adverse from actual entry reference price.
strategies.takeProfit: 40 bps favorable from actual entry reference price.
strategies.invalidation: No signal without two-interval confirmation; no institutional assertion is used as evidence.
strategies.sizing: Fixed 1000 USD notional per trade by default, one open position per strategy run.

strategies.entry: Use only prior 15 bars as trailing bounds. Bullish if current low is below prior trailing low by at least 0.05% and current CVD is higher than CVD at that prior low, with current delta>=0. Bearish mirrors using current high above prior trailing high by at least 0.05%, current CVD lower than CVD at prior high, and current delta<=0.
strategies.entryTiming: Decision at bar idx; fill no earlier than next bar open/snapshot.
strategies.exitOrder: TAKER in frozen adapter; stress scenarios can force taker-heavy exits.
strategies.stop: 25 bps adverse from actual entry reference price.
strategies.takeProfit: 50 bps favorable from actual entry reference price.
strategies.invalidation: No signal before 15-bar lookback; no future extrema or non-causal trailing bounds.
strategies.sizing: Fixed 1000 USD notional per trade by default, one open position per strategy run.
